claim_boundary: C023 formalizes exact Policy-0A memoization as JANUS-FC_local, isolates the missing context-independent reason bridge, and opens two lower-bound routes. No entry proves a Formula-Caching lower bound, P!=NP, or P=NP.

hypotheses.title: Policy-0A to JANUS-FC_local Certificate Equivalence
hypotheses.statement: Every terminating Policy-0A non-affine search execution can be emitted as a polynomially checkable JANUS-FC_local certificate containing exact canonical residual states, unit and local-Resolution events, deterministic branches, cache edges to previously completed states, and the complete charged work ledger; conversely every accepted certificate replays the same Boolean result.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Policy-0A becomes an explicit proof-system object rather than an informal memo dictionary, allowing simulations and lower bounds to target a fixed calculus with charged verification cost.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: establish execution-certificate equivalence for the exact cached policy before comparing its strength with historical Formula Caching, Resolution or Res(⊕).
hypotheses.next_gate: Generalize the finite serialized verifier to a universal induction and prove certificate size and verification time polynomial in calls, states, cache edges, canonicalization and local inference work.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H138 replaces H131's requested FC/CC-style object by the concrete JANUS-FC_local syntax, completion-order cache rule, independent serialized replay and explicit event ledger implemented in C023.
falsification_conditions: A production Policy-0A transition cannot be represented by the certificate syntax.
A forged cache edge, residual key, Boolean result or context is accepted by the independent verifier.
Certificate construction or verification requires superpolynomial work beyond the charged execution.
Two accepted certificates with the same root and deterministic policy replay different answers.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H138 formalizes one exact algorithmic calculus. It does not classify its proof strength or establish a worst-case lower bound.

hypotheses.title: Context-Independent Reason Completion for JANUS-FC_local
hypotheses.statement: Every completed UNSAT residual state reused by JANUS-FC_local admits a polynomial-size, polynomially extractable context-independent reason object that is valid at every exact-cache occurrence and can be composed with the local Resolution ledger without unfolding all cached descendants.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Exact Boolean caching could be upgraded to reason-caching or simulated in a known proof system with polynomial overhead, reopening depth-controlled Resolution or Res(⊕) lower-bound methods against Policy-0A.
hypotheses.proof_role: BARRIER_BREAKER: determine whether identical residual semantics can be represented by one reusable proof reason despite different decision and inherited-unit provenance.
hypotheses.next_gate: Complete the unfolded MAJ3 reason audit, characterize the weakest reusable reason language, and either construct polynomial reasons or exhibit a family forcing superpolynomial context-specific completion.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H139 separates Boolean residual reuse from generalized reason learning, measures decision and full-entry boundary intersections, and makes reason extraction rather than memo lookup the explicit missing theorem.
falsification_conditions: One exact residual is reached in contexts for which no nontrivial common reason exists in the proposed language.
Any reusable reason requires unfolding superpolynomially many cached descendants.
Reason extraction hides SAT, implication or proof search of superpolynomial cost.
Adding the required reason and weakening rules changes the calculus beyond polynomial simulation of Policy-0A.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H139 is open. Empty or differing finite boundaries block naive clauses but do not by themselves prove that all polynomial reason systems fail.

hypotheses.title: Superpolynomial Lower-Bound Route for JANUS-FC_local
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-length UNSAT family, with graph tautologies and MAJ3-lifted Tseitin formulas as current candidates, on which every JANUS-FC_local certificate and therefore every exact Policy-0A execution has superpolynomial charged size even after exact residual reuse and the registered one-pass local Resolution rule.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The exact cached successor of Policy-0T is excluded as a polynomial-time universal SAT policy, forcing a stronger semantic dispatcher, generalized learning, component decomposition or another proof-theoretic resource.
hypotheses.proof_role: ALGORITHMIC_LOWER_BOUND_ROUTE: extend the C022 policy lower-bound program from trees to the exact residual-judgement DAG calculus without treating cache edges as free Resolution sharing.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove robustness of a known basic Formula-Caching lower bound under Policy-0A's bounded local Resolution pass, or develop a direct lifting/communication lower bound for JANUS-FC_local with input-length normalization.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H140 keeps C022's exact-policy scope but replaces tree-to-Resolution simulation by a direct cached-calculus target, informed by finite MAJ3 state growth and graph-tautology probes.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-size JANUS-FC_local certificate family for every proposed hard candidate.
The local Resolution pass destroys the imported basic Formula-Caching lower-bound invariant.
The apparent growth is only exponential in an auxiliary order parameter but polynomial in actual CNF length.
A polynomial simulation into a proof system with polynomial proofs for all candidate families.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H140 targets one exact cached policy calculus. Even a proof would not resolve P versus NP or lower-bound unrestricted SAT algorithms.
